answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 41684 Country: Bangladesh Title: Islamic Names Question: I wish to know whether the word 'Rohan' bears any meaning and if so, can we use it as a name of a new born boy. Answer ID: 41684 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1448/1448/M=1433) We could not get the meaning of Rohan, keep the name Rehan instead which means fragrant plant and it is a good as name. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
